If we are discussing violations of the post-war international order, the facts point clearly to the CCP.

• 1989 Tiananmen Square: peaceful protesters massacred.
• Uyghurs in Xinjiang: mass detention, forced labor, religious repression.
• 2016 UNCLOS ruling (Philippines v. China): a legally binding verdict in favor of the Philippines rejected; the South China Sea militarized.
• Taiwan: a democracy since 1996, yet repeatedly threatened despite the clear will of its people.

New chapters were added in 2025.
• A Chinese diplomat publicly posted a death threat against Japan’s PM.
• Chinese military aircraft maintained fire-control radar lock-on for 30 minutes against JASDF aircraft near Okinawa — a clear CUES violation.

This is why peace-loving countries are alarmed — by the CCP’s actions, not Japan’s.
